name: discomfort
quote: Public speaking is outside my comfort zone.
description: Being outside the tolerable zone of physical, social, or mental discomfort.

variations.name: temporary discomfort
variations.description: If you're aware that the current conditions are not going to last, you probably anticipate better feelings and may be able to repress the discomfort.

variations.name: social discomfort
variations.description: The feeling that you're amongst people who might not accept an important part of your identity.

variations.name: physical discomfort
variations.description: The recognition that your body is experiencing some minor pain.

commentaries.quote: 'Comfort' is relative. We're never truly without some kind of discomfort for long, but some people have higher tolerances physical or social discomfort.

conditions: Self perceives that being amongst a certain social group is somewhat stressful.
Perception that the body is experiencing some minor pain.
